verdict: Organic-only period; both GBP and Instagram softened this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile was the sole source of inbound activity, delivering 97 total actions — 21 calls, 30 direction requests, and 46 website clicks — with no paid advertising running on Meta or Google. In the most recent seven days, GBP actions fell 22% and Instagram reach fell 29% compared to the prior seven days, a confirmed short-term decline rather than routine fluctuation. Because there is no paid spend to cushion organic dips, these drops flow directly to your visibility. Ad campaigns are being reactivated to restore a reliable lead floor so that organic performance is not your only variable. Next period you should see paid activity running alongside organic, which will stabilize inbound volume.
